_comment: Multi-Model Configuration — Example Template. Copy this file to models_settings.json and fill in your API credentials.
_instructions: Each model section requires: api_key (API key), api_base (endpoint URL), model (model name). Leave any field blank to fall back to the default DeepSeek config in .env.

REASONING_MODEL._comment: Primary reasoning model for complex tasks — multi-step reasoning, tool calling, code generation, search synthesis. supports_vision (Direct Vision): set true ONLY when this model accepts OpenAI image_url content parts inline — user-uploaded images are then attached to the current-turn message so the model sees them directly (no tool round-trip); false/absent keeps the text-placeholder + read_file lazy-analysis path. A 400 rejection with images attached self-heals by retrying the turn text-only.

FLASH_MODEL._comment: Lightweight fast model for triage classification and simple conversations (greetings, small talk, /status). Low max_tokens to save cost. supports_vision: see REASONING_MODEL — when true, bare-image messages also enter the agent directly (character responds to the image instead of the legacy 已收到图片 ack).

MULTIMODAL_MODEL._comment: Vision-capable model for image understanding. Must support OpenAI-compatible vision API format (image_url content type). Examples: gpt-4o, claude-3-opus, Qwen2.5-VL.

AUDIO_MODEL._comment: Audio-capable model for voice message understanding. Must support OpenAI-compatible input_audio content type. Examples: gpt-4o-audio-preview, gemini-2.0-flash. Falls back to MULTIMODAL_MODEL if left empty.

OCR_MODEL._comment: Dedicated OCR model for the battle-screenshot pipeline (action-order panel text). Defaults to qwen3.5-ocr when model is left blank. Leave the whole section empty to fall back to MULTIMODAL_MODEL credentials + qwen3.5-ocr.

IMAGE_GEN_MODEL._comment: Image generation (Bond P4, lib/media_gen.py). DashScope-native synchronous endpoint — api_base is the FULL endpoint URL, NOT a /chat/completions base. Billed per image; the section is fresh-read on every call (hot), except max_concurrency which latches at first use and needs a bot restart. Text-to-image and reference-image editing share this endpoint. Leave api_key/api_base/model empty to disable image generation.

TTS_MODEL._comment: Speech synthesis (Bond P4, lib/media_gen.py). DashScope-native non-realtime endpoint — api_base is the FULL endpoint URL. Billed per character. Voices cannot be mixed across TTS models; pick voice IDs from the Bailian 'Qwen-Audio-TTS voice list' (the placeholders below are examples). output.audio.url expires after 24h — media_gen downloads it immediately. default_voice is used when a character has no assigned voice; voice_pool feeds deterministic per-character voice assignment. Same hot-reload semantics as IMAGE_GEN_MODEL.

task_routing._comment: Task routing rules — which model handles which task type. triage = model used for complexity classification. simple_task = model for simple conversations. complex_task = model for complex reasoning. image_analysis = model for multimodal image understanding. audio_analysis = model for audio/voice understanding.
task_routing.triage_prompt:
请判断以下用户消息的复杂度，只回复一个词'simple'或'complex'。

判断标准：
- simple: 简单问候、闲聊、已知事实询问、无需工具调用的常识问题
- complex: 需要搜索、需要执行代码、需要读取文件、需要多步推理、涉及专业知识
